title: BookPage: render the available boolean as "Available" / "On loan"
goal: On the book page, show the book's availability as words instead of true/false. (Loans do not exist yet: use the fixture's available field only.)
spec:
A book is "On loan" when the fixture says so or when it is part of one of the member's loans; otherwise it is "Available".

BK-3: A book that is on loan says "On loan" and cannot be picked (no "Add to my picks" button, or a disabled one); a book that is already picked says "Already in your picks" and cannot be picked again.
